description: Source code for upload logs functionality, including log upload checks, configuration retrieval, and process management for uploading logs in a device management system.

methods.name: checkXpkiMtlsBasedLogUpload
methods.description: Checks for the presence of specific files to determine if XPKI MTLS log upload is enabled.

methods.name: checkmTlsLogUploadFlag
methods.description: Retrieves and checks the RFC parameter to determine if MTLS log upload is enabled.

methods.name: checkLogUploadBeforeDeepSleepFlag
methods.description: Retrieves and checks the RFC parameter to determine if log upload before deep sleep is enabled.

methods.name: getDCMconfigDetails
methods.description: Extracts upload protocol, link, and check settings from DCM configuration file content.

methods.name: getUploadLogParameters
methods.description: Gathers parameters needed for log upload, including server, protocol, and URL, considering configuration flags.

methods.name: LogUploadBeforeDeepSleep
methods.description: Initiates log upload process before device enters deep sleep, if enabled.

methods.name: logUploadAsync
methods.description: Starts an asynchronous log upload process by forking a new process.
